description: Na₂ZrGeO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.89 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.82 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.85 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.85 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 22°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.21 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 21°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.21 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-49°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.79 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-49°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.79 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ZrGe tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ZrGe trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ZrGe trigonal pyramids.
